race.title: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
race.verdict: The unexposed SEDRO WOOLLEY was good value for his victory here last month, seeing off a next-time-out winner, and can follow up back over 1m after a 4 lb rise. The Bear Trap and Magna Gee Gee are a couple of the other more appealing types. SEDRO WOOLLEY (IRE) THE BEAR TRAP (IRE) MAGNA GEE GEE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: The Bear Trap (7/2), Roman Harry (4/1), Sedro Woolley (5/1), Jasmine Affanalis (6/1), Magna Gee Gee (10/1), Rampage (12/1), La Campanella (12/1), Sayonara (12/1), Local Lad (14/1), Whistling Jamesie (14/1), Jackandthefox (20/1), Miss Abby Jools (20/1), Cosmic Force (25/1), Pure Valour (33/1), Tijuana (33/1), Manhattan Dandy (33/1)
